030package dev.visdb.seesaw.datasources.products;
031
032import javax.sql.RowSet;
033
034import dev.visdb.seesaw.datasources.DbOps;
035import dev.visdb.seesaw.navigate.RowsModel;
036
037/**
038 * Stash one of these into lookup to create a {@link DbOps}. Only used if one
039 * is not provided to
040 * {@link RowsModel#create(javax.sql.RowSet, dev.visdb.seesaw.datasources.DbOps)
041 * RowsModel.create(RowSet, DbOps)}
042 * or
043 * {@link RowsModel#setRowSet(javax.sql.RowSet, dev.visdb.seesaw.datasources.DbOps)
044 * rowsModel.setRowSet(RowSet, DbOps)}
045 */
046public interface DbOpsCreator {
047  /**
048   * Return a {@link DbOps} that works with the specified RowSet.
049   * Typically called when a RowSet is assigned to a RowsModel.
050   *
051   * @param rs needing a DbOps
052   * @param rowsModel before the RowSet is assigned, null if not yet created.
053   * @return DbOps may be null and caller should keep looking.
054   */
055  DbOps create(RowSet rs, RowsModel rowsModel);
056}
